verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page says it sends meeting action items into JIRA and Asana, and other integrations push action items to ClickUp. It also offers an API, webhooks and Zapier, so an agent or automation could route automatically extracted next steps into a tracker. Missing for 10: any mention of Linear, in-depth docs on how the Jira/Asana sync works (whether it runs automatically per meeting, field mapping, plan availability beyond Enterprise), API/webhook reference detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
